items.caption: This modern seal-style drawing shows 火, the fire element named in the traditional analysis of 熱; it illustrates the component, not its form within the full character.
items.alt: A black, seal-style 火 glyph centered on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It clearly depicts the documented fire element associated with 熱, while the caption makes clear that it is not a historical drawing of the compound.

limitations.text: The traditional analysis names 火 and 埶 in 熱, but this image shows only 火. No verified glyph drawing here shows 熱 or 埶, so their historical shapes and the early graphic development of 熱 remain uncertain.
